rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No banned words (honest, delve, landscape, importantly, crucial, substrate, leverage, synergize, paradigm shift) found in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Ritual / practice (noun) / ceremony — hard ban
rules_evaluated.evidence: No use of ritual, practice (noun), or ceremony in body (lines 1-110). AE101 M2 absolute ban enforced.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no fixed retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No session biography markers. File history tracked in git.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Register match.
rules_evaluated.evidence: AE101 student-facing exercise. Register consistent: concrete, direct, warm, earned jargon. Matches quintet voice (Boris/Martin/Godin/Rory/Risto balance).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not an article draft.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Matt Pocock credited for grill-me at line 81 within body prose, properly attributed. Attribution placed at point of reference in exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always you, never the student; teacher framing stays out of body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body uses second person throughout. No third-person 'the student', no 'trainer says', no delivery mechanics in body prose.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Terms like 'grill-me' credited explicitly at point of use. Concepts like 'plan mode' operationally taught. No smuggled maintainer vocabulary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No reassurance-shaped sentences. Prose uses directive register without apologizing for pragmatism. No 'it's OK if', 'no penalty', 'not a downgrade' found.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not a reference artifact in scope.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Matt Pocock attributed once in body (line 81). Klaassen and Martin cited only in backing blocks (below maintainer cut). Single attribution rule honored.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Punchy claims held sharp: line 9 'Making the plan good is the work', line 29 'never let the agent say everything'. No softening hedges.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No value-prop framing, positioning defense, or vendor-comparison language in body. No 'not aspirational', 'real practitioners', 'grounded in actual' phrases.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.
rules_evaluated.evidence: M2 exercise. 'Plan mode' introduced operationally at line 20. No jargon planted before earning moment in training arc. Vocabulary level matches M2 position.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Section closers have clear referents. Line 39 closer references 'two push-backs forming in your head'. No dangling pronouns or bypass-agent directives.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Standard shape for **What happened:** block — three moves.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 109: (1) 'One plan, two reads' (count+noun), (2) 'in your own words'/'Two push-backs' (qualifier), (3) 'on the record' (destination). Follows three-move shape correctly.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Agent verbs are peer-flat: ask, draft, acknowledge, regenerate, walk, hand, explores, pauses. No combative verbs (bark, order, command, whip, force, drag, push, boss, snap).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All headers describe actual mechanisms: 'Bring a real task', 'Enter plan mode', 'Push back twice', 'Walk down branches', 'Answer the branches', 'Stop', 'Approve', 'Compare'. No spatial metaphors contradict mechanism.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Machine-cadence fat — the shape of good prose without the content.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No empty negations used gratuitously. No deictic drumroll ('that is the X'). No bold-label echoes. No citation duplication in body prose.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 5 frames skill aspirationally: 'That gap is the skill this module is building.' Positive framing of the learning outcome.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: M2 position allows M1 abbreviation 'M1' per carve-out. 'Plan mode' operationally introduced at line 20 with context. Terms earned on use or via prior module context.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).
rules_evaluated.evidence: AE101 engineers audience. No business jargon (synergy, leverage, paradigm shift, orchestrate, optimize, ecosystem) found in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context — use deliberately.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not addressed in exercise body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Golden path only in body — with boundary exception for needed recovery.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No recovery branches needed. Exercise flows golden path throughout.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not addressed in exercise body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned at every module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise does not include Debrief with compound retro. Phase 5 is pattern-naming, not retro interview.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise maintains consistent AE101 voice throughout. No M1 joyful-creation register or M5 unease register smuggled.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lines 36-38 teach HOW to read a plan critically (the skill), not error-catching. Student learns the practice; 'notice' is analytical, not verification.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Simulation personas never alone.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No simulation personas in exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No 'What research says' callout boxes.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No callout boxes in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student moves stay in conversation with agent.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All student actions (reading, pushing back, asking Claude, approving) stay in chat. No editor/terminal/file-edit forcing functions in main exercise body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Specify which CLAUDE.md layer — every time.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 107 specifies './CLAUDE.local.md' (personal, gitignored). Correct layer named explicitly.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No em-dashes found in body. Sentences are simple or properly parenthetical, not sub-clause-heavy.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Section headers use command verbs when section is about doing something.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All exercise section headers use command verbs: 'Bring', 'Enter', 'Push back', 'Walk down', 'Answer', 'Stop', 'Approve', 'Compare'. Exercise body is all action.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Links at line 25 use titles: '[Multi-session and Git: survival guide]', '[Claude Code for engineers]'. No bare filenames or backticked paths.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Disambiguate shared-word collisions with Claude Code primitives on first student-authored use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise uses 'agent' (line 5) and 'Claude' (line 20) distinctly. Context makes distinction clear. Exercise does not ask student to author agents or plans, so rule may not strictly apply.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: LLM-vs-agent-vs-Claude vocabulary discipline.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Agent used when acting (drafting, regenerating, walking). Claude used when addressee or product. Consistent use supports agency framing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Session / task / run split.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Task used correctly (line 5, 20). Session understood contextually. No misuse of 'run' in body for agent work.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No time-of-day phrases (tomorrow, overnight, morning, evening) found in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No labels announcing reflection ('Pause before', 'Meta-moment', 'Step back', 'Moment of truth'). Reflection embedded naturally in action.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No meta-ask when student has already decided.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise does not ask Claude to ask student about prior decisions. No meta-loops present.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: `.md` is default file type for student artifacts.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise references `.md` files in prompt markers (registry), not addressed in body prose.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Every line teaches the practice or supports the exercise. No administrative asides, unnecessary detail, or implementation mechanism exposed.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body 'read it'/'look at it'/'notice X' after chat-print = dead weight.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lines 36-38 teach HOW to read (instructional scaffolding before Claude prints). No redundant 'read it' or 'look at' after agent output.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lines 99-102 forward-look at pattern naming. Student is implicit agent of learned skill ('you read', 'you catch'). No audience-shift or role-gating.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Operational reminders live at moment of use, not only introduced.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Prompt markers reference runtime destinations and modes implicitly via registry expansion. No operational reminders buried in earlier sections only.
